mentions.name: Calendar for YNAB
mentions.description: This integration takes scheduled transactions from YNAB and displays them in any normal calendar application, with plans to add historical transactions to help with reconciling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a small integration to take scheduled transactions in YNAB and display them in any normal calendar application. I’m hoping to add historical transactions one day as well to help with reconciling.
